text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"sustained multi-paragraph examples about class projects and group work","quality":"development","description":"It develops ideas with extended examples and elaboration rather than brief unsupported statements."},{"evidence":"clear topic sentences like \"Another reason\" and \"Also if the teacher lets students pick people\"","quality":"organization","description":"It uses more explicit paragraph-level structure and transitions to guide the reader through the argument."},{"evidence":"\"If I hadn't had my partner, I probably would not have finished the project in time\"","quality":"sentence control","description":"It shows more control over complex sentence forms and conditional structures."},{"evidence":"\"made good friends\" \"help them\" \"productive\"","quality":"word choice","description":"It uses somewhat more natural and precise vocabulary for academic argument and description."},{"evidence":"fewer phrases like \"there are so much students\" and \"build it by theirsleves\"","quality":"grammar accuracy","description":"It has fewer subject-verb agreement, article, and pronoun errors that interfere with clarity."},{"evidence":"\"working with partners is beneficial\" repeated consistently throughout","quality":"focus","description":"It stays more consistently centered on one line of argument without drifting as much."}]}
